Definition: probably of Hebrew origin (H6865); Syria (i.e. Tsyria or Tyre), a region of Asia:--Syria.
BiblicalUsage: His fame goes throughout all Syria, and they bring to Him all sick people, and He heals them, and the taxing is first made when Cyrenius is governor of Syria, and Paul goes through Syria and Cilicia, confirming the churches. Syria is the region north of Israel, the road between Galilee and the wider world, and the gospel travels through it from the first.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the fame of Jesus went throughout all Syria because the sick kept coming, and I hold that a region that once heard of Him can hear of Him again.
